demo.program:
# Rumi — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Rumi known for?", "Masnavi"),
    ("What field did Rumi work in?", "poetry"),
    ("What is lived?", "1207-1273"),
    ("What is field?", "poetry"),
    ("What is known for?", "Masnavi"),
    ("What is note?", "The best-selling poet in America, 800 years on"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
